description: This source file implements fundamental functions for a command-line interface shell component, including creation, initialization, object enrollment, and removal of a shell object within a network device or embedded system environment.

classes.name: SCLI_SHELL_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object representing the shell, containing function pointers and properties for managing CLI sessions and behaviors.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE ScliShoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new shell object, setting up essential properties and function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the shell object, releasing allocated resources and cleaning up sessions.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls required interface objects for TSP and CEN, allocating and setting their properties.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the shell object by setting properties, function pointers, and default configurations.
